notes.title: Steampost of Lesser Updates 2
notes.content:
We’ve been hard at work on the game and our new feature complete demo. It’s all coming together steadily, and we thought it’s time to share some more with you:

[h2]It's not gambling - you're not playing for money. Just for your life.[/h2]
Cormo has long left behind his ruinous habit of gambling. But it's hard to lose old habits. They don't want to lose you either.

On your explorations you’ll come across dice. Cormo fidgets with them, reminiscing for a moment before tossing them. He’ll never know what he rolled… [b][u]but you will[/u][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458508/1eaa0ad9a92fce75a90e7c530bfd6e92160fadd0.gif[/img]

Scenarios are high risk actions that can be attempted using rolled dice - or just leaving it up to luck or fate.

This might be performing an acrobatic feat, trying not to throw up, or deciding whether Cormo’s will or yours will prevail. But the most important of them all is of course - FISHING.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458508/de1e0a5972ebed66b4193d3626f729ea43862eb4.gif[/img]

Cormo can find fishing spots - but he never seems to catch any fish. In our game, you will fish out everything BUT fish - from utensils to old memorabilia. But don’t be sad, these items can be repurposed as [b][u]gifts you can give to other characters[/u][/b], but more on that in a later update.

[h2]Constellations of the Mind[/h2]
Where Birds Go to Sleep features “knowledge puzzles” akin to those in Outer Wilds; puzzles you might not even realise are there at first, and once you know the solution to them, you can solve them within minutes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458508/d66722b35e7c10cc6c9920c22a1d13fa707257f6.gif[/img]

As you explore, you will come across clues to puzzles that will be collected into your Mindmap in the form of clue cards. The Mindmap screen is like a quest log, and it is an essential part of the experience.

[h2]A Tapestry Within[/h2]
Almost every dialogue choice in the game subtly changes Cormo’s personality. The personality stats you get from choices were previously not shown anywhere at all, causing a lot of confusion as to what choices really did. Later, we created a section for them in the Inventory but it felt a bit too cramped. Now, stats have their own screen with flashy artwork and animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458508/175f33761e84317c39ce7fb15b9ccf7982681fbf.gif[/img]

The stats affect things big and small - a different description, a different option, a different inner world - a different Cormo, wrestling for control against you based on these stats.

[h2]Chart the Unknown[/h2]
In a few of our previous news posts, you could get a glimpse of our exploration mechanics and the map. In our next update, we’ll show more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458508/7e2e8a6701590012028c1a3eef28e9b655892157.png[/img]

[h2]Help us make the game better![/h2]
The time for our new demo releasing is drawing ever closer. We've run a few rounds of testing on our Discord server that yielded invaluable feedback, helping us shape the game and make it better. We'd like to continue this trend, so if that's something you're interested in, join our server for when the new testing call opens: https://discord.gg/YSFbT3HzrH

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458508/c4b7a99d148984ee2fcc516da9f09087eaf78bb7.gif[/img]

notes.title: Steampost of Lesser Updates
notes.content:
Sorry for the long radio silence. We have been working hard on the game and made some really great progress. We're still working on our feature complete demo and have been prototyping different maps.

Here are a couple of things we've already implemented:

[h2]Inventory and Stats[/h2]
If you have played our public demo, you'll remember the “Mindmap” screen, which was accessed by pressing “M” contained ideas about everything - the quests, the items you carry and lore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458508/41a5d1f67e9ba3b7d2664b94835d8c5f04378245.gif[/img]

The Mindmap has been separated into more traditional categories. The first is the [b]inventory[/b] which allows you to browse, inspect, equip and use your collected items. Your accrued character traits were hidden in the previous demo, but now the system is transparent and you will be able keep track of them.

There’s also Thoughts, Clues and Nighthawks, we’ll keep those for another update.



[h2]Further UI Redesigns and Polish[/h2]
We have been hard at work on a big UI overhaul, polish and quality of life improvements. We want to save some of the bigger ones for the next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458508/fc693fd3bd96f14cd2c3d4a31bc7e72f82e7fdcb.gif[/img]
New items get marked in the inventory by a dot on the tab it's in, and get a sheen to signal they're new.


[h2]Narrative Log & Dialogue Skipping[/h2]
Due to popular demand, we have implemented a narrative log. You'll be able to summon it during dialogues to see what has been said, and the options you have chosen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458508/82e714e62e56126c9f846aa2cb6868372116819b.png[/img]

Another very sought after feature - “dialogue skipping” has been in the plans forever but originally we only wanted to enable it if you were replaying the game - this is not the case anymore, it'll be available from the get-go.

When you press "cancel" (ie "B" on an xbox controller), a text popup will appear on the bottom of your screen telling you to press it again to skip, to prevent you from accidentally skipping.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458508/d65b32e5d115834f41acdbb5e793086e4af59216.png[/img]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [th][h2]Day/Night Cycle[/h2][/th]
        [th][/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]We have not mentioned this in the past, but the game features a day/night cycle!

Actually, it’s more of a morning/dusk/midnight cycle.

The three different daytime states make different areas accessible, they are used in various puzzles and give the world a different look. 
[/td]
        [td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458508/6439fc68cffa608f8f4c9c66a805e193f625c14d.gif[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458508/7e2e8a6701590012028c1a3eef28e9b655892157.png[/img]



Feedback is super important to us, and we're looking forward to releasing our feature complete demo into the wild to see what you all have to say about it!

[i]And last but not least… FISHING. Yes, you can fish in the game. Look out for the next update to keep up with Cormo’s angling escapades.[/i]

notes.title: Big Demo Update and Tiny Teams
notes.content:
We are very excited to say that we're participating in TinyTeams 2022, and that our demo will be available again from the 1st of August until an unspecified date (at least until the 8th).

If you have the demo in your Steam library already, you'll already see an update for the demo - the build will have "0.71" (or higher) on the top left corner. If you don't, you will be able to access the demo again on the 1st of August!

We would love to hear your thoughts on the changes and the new content, and if you run into any issues!

[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]
- New endscreen that shows your path taken in the demo
- A new dialogue path for the argument with Dunlin
- Shireen's Locket dream made more apparent
- WASD/Gamepad support!!
- A lot of voice lines have been cut up to be shorter so dialogue is quicker (more like movie subtitles)
- Resolutions now wont list every resolution under the sun, just the relevant ones
- Mindmap notifcation reworked, now hopefully more obvious
- Ability to dream on before waking up

[u][b]Things to note:[/b][/u]
- Due to changes made to the structure of saves, your saves from previous versions of the demo will not be compatible (the game will act like you have no saves, this is intended). 
- Your settings will also reset on first startup due to changes to settings, namely that you cannot rebind keys in the demo, and you cannot use both dyslexia font and font size at the same time.

Those of you on Linux, you might have to opt into a beta branch by inputting the following password: wherepenguinsgotosleep

notes.title: Demo Updates + Linux version
notes.content:
A couple of small updates were pushed these past day. The update will show V0.42 (or higher) in the top left corner of the main menu.

- Lots of small art fixes
- Feedback form no longer shows the two unintended "Option Text" buttons that lead to a softlock
- The mindmap notification that pops up in the top right corner has been made yellow and a bit bigger for easier visibility
- Fixed a few buttons staying onscreen when they should have disappeared
- Fixed a few buttons displaying as unavailable when they should be interactable
- An issue was fixed where after the first line, the end screen was not interactive
- End screen should now properly display the buttons to leave the game after the demo ends

[b]Linux players, an experimental Linux build has been made available![/b] 
You should be able to download the demo now on the store page and opt into the Linux branch using "wherepenguinsgotosleep" as a password!

notes.title: Big Demo Fix Update
notes.content:
The big fix update for the demo is now up! The update will show V0.32 (or higher) in the top left corner of the main menu.

[u][b]This update will fix the following issues in the demo:[/b][/u]
♢ Most importantly, fixed saving and loading saves
♢ Un-fried the feedback form[i]*[/i]
♢ "Snake's Tongue" achievement fixed
♢ End screen not fading out from black softlock fixed
♢ An alternate path in Dunlin convincing dialogue post first sleep is now available
♢ Adjusted how pausing works (you should be able to pause now normally unless a voiced line is playing)
♢ Mindmap can be exited using the pause button
♢ Mindmap can be exited anytime (even when an entry is displayed onscreen)
♢ Thought prompts updated to be more legible
♢ Fixed softlocks in the beach (shoes) and bonfire introspection sections
♢ Fixed white screen on endscreen and some other similar screens
♢ Thought prompts now clickable normally without having to use keyboard buttons
♢ Fixed some typos

*[i]Please send us feedback! We want to hear about your experience![/i]

Apologies for any issues caused earlier and we hope the update fixed any problems you've encountered before!

Also apologies to those not on a QWERTY keyboard about the non-rebindable up/down keys, we will allow these to be rebindable the next time the demo will be public!
